# QnALog 1.6.0

## Highlights

- Rebuild the outline for an entire conversation log, with a verbatim backup made before the existing outline is replaced.
- Preserve continuation sources and continuous numbering, and navigate and play accumulated audio from multiple sources in order.
- Keep transcript text after a live-transcription end marker and insert returned text literally, including replacement-string characters.
- Recover the intent to discard a very short recording when cleanup fails, so the queued operation can be retried without losing its state.
- Pause malformed or unknown queue entries while preserving their original records and protecting referenced audio from cleanup.
- Localize the Original/draft label and reorganization task status text.
- Improve the repository backup-restore CLI's path, link, and overlap validation. This is a command-line maintenance tool, not a plugin button.

## User impact

No settings schema, API key storage, provider, or device-selection changes. No reconfiguration is required. QnALog does not batch-edit or translate existing notes. Existing filenames and user-defined type names remain unchanged, and no feature is removed.

Backups are created only when the corresponding rebuild, install, or restore operation runs. This release does not automatically back up historical notes or provide unlimited version history.
